errors.evidence: The reference description states France is represented in gray, but the machine-generated description incorrectly assigns orange to France.
The reference description states China/continental is represented in orange, but the machine-generated description incorrectly assigns light gray to China/continental.
The reference description states Turkey is represented in light green, but the machine-generated description incorrectly assigns light blue/turquoise to Turkey.
The reference description states the USA is represented in green, but the machine-generated description incorrectly assigns light green to the USA, which is closer to Turkey's color in the figure.
The reference description states Argentina is represented in dark blue, but the machine-generated description incorrectly assigns dark gray to Argentina.

errors.text_span: В рамките на всяка годишна група стълбовете са подредени най-общо в низходящ ред на височината си от ляво надясно, като следват точно последователността на изброяване в легендата.
errors.evidence: The machine-generated description incorrectly states that the bars are arranged in descending order of height from left to right. The figure shows the bars follow the order in the legend, not sorted by height.
The reference description mentions that the values for none of the countries change over the period, but the machine-generated description omits this detail.

The reference description explicitly states the highest values are for Spain, around 950 thousand hectares, but the machine-generated description only mentions 'immediately below the 1000 thousand hectares line' without specifying the approximate value.
